t: Post Consumer Brands facts for kids
s: In 2015, Post Foods bought MOM Brands (formerly Malt-O-Meal Co.). This made Post the third-largest breakfast cereal company in the U.S. At this point, Post Foods changed its name to Post Consumer Brands and moved its main office to Lakeville, Minnesota. In July 2017, Post Holdings bought Weetabix Limited for about £1.4 billion. In 2019, the company started combining some of its MOM Brands and Weetabix cereals under the Three Sisters Cereal name. On December 8, 2020, Post Holdings announced it was buying the Peter Pan peanut butter brand from Conagra Brands.
